verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 3.56
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.56

verses.pali: 6. Brāhmaṇavagga
verses.english: 6. Brahmins

verses.pali: Palokasutta
verses.english: Breaking Apart

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇamahāsālo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇamahāsālo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a well-to-do Brahmin went up to the Buddha, and seated to one side he said to him:

verses.pali: “sutaṁ metaṁ, bho gotama, pubbakānaṁ brāhmaṇānaṁ vuddhānaṁ mahallakānaṁ ācariyapācariyānaṁ bhāsamānānaṁ:
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, I have heard that brahmins of the past who were elderly and senior, the tutors of tutors, said:

verses.pali: ‘pubbe sudaṁ ayaṁ loko avīci maññe phuṭo ahosi manussehi, kukkuṭasaṁpātikā gāmanigamarājadhāniyo’ti.
verses.english: ‘In the old days this world was so full of humans you’d think they were squashed together. The villages, towns and capital cities were no more than a chicken’s flight apart.’

verses.pali: Ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu ko paccayo yenetarahi manussānaṁ khayo hoti, tanuttaṁ paññāyati, gāmāpi agāmā honti, nigamāpi anigamā honti, nagarāpi anagarā honti, janapadāpi ajanapadā hontī”ti?
verses.english: What is the cause, sir, what is the reason why these days human numbers have dwindled, a decline in population is evident, and whole villages, towns, cities, and countries have disappeared?”

verses.pali: “Etarahi, brāhmaṇa, manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobhābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā.
verses.english: “These days, brahmin, humans just love illicit desire. They’re overcome by immoral greed, and mired in wrong custom.

verses.pali: Te adhammarāgarattā visamalobhābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā tiṇhāni satthāni gahetvā aññamaññaṁ jīvitā voropenti, tena bahū manussā kālaṁ karonti.
verses.english: Taking up sharp knives, they murder each other. And so many people perish.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, hetu ayaṁ paccayo yenetarahi manussānaṁ khayo hoti, tanuttaṁ paññāyati, gāmāpi agāmā honti, nigamāpi anigamā honti, nagarāpi anagarā honti, janapadāpi ajanapadā honti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why these days human numbers have dwindled.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, brāhmaṇa, etarahi manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobhābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā.
verses.english: Furthermore, because these days humans just love illicit desire …

verses.pali: Tesaṁ adhammarāgarattānaṁ visamalobhābhibhūtānaṁ micchādhammaparetānaṁ devo na sammādhāraṁ anuppavecchati.
verses.english: the heavens don’t provide enough rain,

verses.pali: Tena dubbhikkhaṁ hoti dussassaṁ setaṭṭhikaṁ salākāvuttaṁ.
verses.english: so there’s famine, a bad harvest, with crops blighted and turned to straw.

verses.pali: Tena bahū manussā kālaṁ karonti.
verses.english: And so many people perish.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, hetu ayaṁ paccayo yenetarahi manussānaṁ khayo hoti, tanuttaṁ paññāyati, gāmāpi agāmā honti, nigamāpi anigamā honti, nagarāpi anagarā honti, janapadāpi ajanapadā honti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why these days human numbers have dwindled.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, brāhmaṇa, etarahi manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobhābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā.
verses.english: Furthermore, because these days humans just love illicit desire …

verses.pali: Tesaṁ adhammarāgarattānaṁ visamalobhābhibhūtānaṁ micchādhammaparetānaṁ yakkhā vāḷe amanusse ossajjanti, tena bahū manussā kālaṁ karonti.
verses.english: native spirits let vicious monsters loose. And so many humans perish.

verses.pali: Ayampi kho, brāhmaṇa, hetu ayaṁ paccayo yenetarahi manussānaṁ khayo hoti, tanuttaṁ paññāyati, gāmāpi agāmā honti, nigamāpi anigamā honti, nagarāpi anagarā honti, janapadāpi ajanapadā hontī”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why these days human numbers have dwindled.”

verses.pali: “Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe…
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! Excellent! …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
